title: SigDistill document distillery
description: The Signature Document Distillery is a Signature original: a document pipeline that partitions any file into typed SigElements, cleans, chunks, and stages them for embedding with one SigFlow declaration. Its element schema, chunking strategies, and connector protocol are original Signature designs.

demo.program:
print('sigflow distill docs/ -> staged elements for embedding')
print('edition: Signature original')
demo.expected_output:
sigflow distill docs/ -> staged elements for embedding
edition: Signature original
